description: This Java class 'MediaFormatBuilder' provides static methods for constructing and configuring MediaFormat objects, including setting codec-specific data and parsing Opus configuration data for media processing.

classes.name: MediaFormatBuilder
classes.description: A utility class for building and configuring MediaFormat objects for media playback and processing.

methods.name: setCodecSpecificData
methods.description: Sets codec-specific data in a MediaFormat object using provided byte arrays.

methods.name: createAudioFormat
methods.description: Creates and configures a MediaFormat object for audio, including optional ADTS header flag.

methods.name: starboardParseOpusConfigurationData
methods.description: Parses Opus codec configuration data to extract pre-skip and pre-roll timing information, returning related byte arrays.
